scenario: A real estate investor sells a relinquished investment property and needs to execute a 1031 like-kind exchange. The workflow extracts the closing date and sale proceeds from the settlement statement PDF, computes the IRS-mandated 45-day identification deadline and 180-day replacement property closing deadline from the sale close date, and generates a compliance status report showing whether the investor is on track to complete the exchange within the required windows.
info_flow: pdf-extract reads the closing settlement statement and outputs the sale close date and net proceeds → temporal-cortex-datetime computes the Day 45 identification deadline and Day 180 replacement closing deadline from the close date → afrexai-real-estate-engine synthesizes a 1031 exchange compliance report showing deadline status, boot exposure, and whether the exchange is on track.
